study type: Retrospective review and systematic literature search
exposure: Chemotherapy for ovarian malignancy during pregnancy
outcome: Safety and efficacy of chemotherapy during pregnancy
cohort: 100 pregnant women diagnosed with ovarian malignancy from June 2011 to July 2021
finding: Chemotherapy for ovarian malignancy during pregnancy appears safe, with 28 out of 43 treated patients delivering healthy newborns, 13 experiencing transient neonatal abnormalities, and 2 neonatal deaths.
